name: psychology_websites_recommender
description: Recommends professional psychology websites based on the given problem type, user group, and number of results to return. The output will be a list of recommended websites with a brief summary on the issue based on the website.

situation.description: The situation user encounters that reveal's the user's current suffer.

problem_type.description: The specific psychological or social problem.

domain.description: The domain of the psychological issue.

user_group.description: The age group of the user for tailored recommendations.

topk.description: The number of top relevant websites to return.
